FusedLayerNorm.note: New Python derived from the independent public population-statistics/affine specifications, not recovered historical source. Preserve FP32 inputs, BF16 outputs and full original IO scope; explicit uint64-to-FP32 counts and native loop casts replace Lean-only toReal. Source execution and numerical domains are re-proved for the actual typed reads. Welford writes both scalar outputs at zero; LayerNorm retains its second input read and empty-row case. Separate arithmetic uses enable_fp_fusion=False. The uint64 full-constructor semantics is now enforced: the Real population-statistics claims explicitly require N < 2^64 to exclude count wraparound. This corrects the old overbroad all-Nat Real claim; formulas are unchanged. Public FP specifications already require N <= CountConversion.limit and retain their original headers. Python and quoted Lean kernels are byte-identical to the published source.

Separate arithmetic requires enable_fp_fusion=False.
